description: {"description":"Alabama Sweet Tea Co. is a Southern sweet tea brand founded in 2015 by Wes Willis (musician) and Golson Foshee (real estate developer) in Montgomery, Alabama. Originally a food truck popping up at events across Alabama, they parked at the Magnolia Food Truck Park (The Silos) in Waco, Texas in 2022, and also operate a storefront at The Wharf in Orange Beach, Alabama.
